title: “Label from Somewhere”: Reflexive Annotating for Situated AI Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of annotator fairness judgments and reflexive rationales on a job vacancy text intentionally loaded with gender discrimination cues (e.g., targeting women for support roles in a male-dominated team).
Eliciting fairness judgments and identity-based reflections from crowd workers on a job description seeking a 'recent graduate with a youthful and energetic attitude'.
Evaluating annotator fairness perceptions and reflexive tagging on a luxury skincare advertisement containing exclusionary language related to class, wealth, and perfectionist beauty ideals.
Capturing annotator critiques and fairness ratings regarding a job vacancy text that explicitly required 'native English proficiency', discriminating against fluent bilinguals.

Deploying a reflexive annotation interface that prompts workers to tag text passages with multiple overlapping social identity facets (e.g., Gender, Race, Class, Ability) to explain how their lived experiences shape their subjective evaluation of fairness.
